user.title: Unavailable Entity Monitor
user.description: Configure the timeout duration and exclusion label.

entity_unavailable.title: {entity_id} is {state}
entity_unavailable.description: The entity **{entity_id}** has been **{state}** for more than {timeout} minutes.

data.action: How you would like to fix this:

exclude_entity.title: Confirm Exclusion
exclude_entity.description:
Adding the **{label_name}** label to **{entity_id}** will mean you won't be told if this entity is unavailable again.

Are you sure you want to label this entity?

ignore_for_now.title: Ignore For Now
ignore_for_now.description: This will remove the issue now, but it will reappear the next time **{entity_id}** becomes unavailable or HomeAssistant is restarted.

power_cycle.title: Select Power Switch
power_cycle.description: Select the switch used to power cycle **{entity_id}**:

confirm_power_cycle.title: Confirm Power Cycle
confirm_power_cycle.description:
The switch **{switch_id}** has been **{state}** for {time_ago}. 

Are you sure you want to turn it off and back on again?

confirm_turn_on.title: Confirm Turn On
confirm_turn_on.description:
The switch **{switch_id}** is currently **off** and was last changed {time_ago} ago.

Would you like to turn it on?
